project: Metafxclub AI Agent HQ Virtual Office
purpose: Local-first durable memory and archive layer for agent recall, mission handoff, meeting context, and report discovery.
principles: Runtime UI session is not long-term memory.
Agent events are append-only operational logs.
Memory index stores durable summaries and pointers to source files.
Secrets, tokens, cookies, and live trading credentials must never be stored here.
Old work should be summarized before being pulled into a new mission thread.

memory_index.description: Searchable metadata cards for old work, docs, reports, contracts, and handoff notes.

agent_notes.description: Role-specific notes and durable working preferences.

meeting_transcripts.description: Append-only meeting sessions, turns, decisions, and next actions.

mission_summaries.description: Closed-session summaries that can be searched by Mission Archivist.

reports.description: Backtest, optimization, VPS, Telegram, and executive reports.

artifacts.description: Non-secret generated files linked from reports and missions.

screenshots.description: Visual evidence for UI, reports, or trading workflow reviews.

mission_archivist: all non-secret summaries and index cards
